actual_added.statement: theorem ae_predictable_private_seed_expectedFixed_excess {Ω : Type u} {Seed : Type v} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [MeasurableSpace Seed] (μ : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (Y : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (hY : ∀ t, Measurable (Y t)) (hlaw : ∀ t, IdentDistrib (Y t) (Y 0) μ μ) (hb : ∀ t, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, Y t ω ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (hind : iIndepFun Y μ) (S : Ω → Seed) (hS : Measurable S) (hseed : IndepFun S (fun ω t => Y t ω) μ) (F : ℕ → MeasurableSpace Ω) (hF : ∀ t, F t ≤ privateSeedPastInformation S Y t) (prediction : ℕ → Ω → ℝ) (hP : ∀ t, AEStronglyMeasurable[F t] (prediction t) μ) (hpb : ∀ t, ∀ᵐ ω ∂μ, prediction t ω ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1) (T : ℕ) : expectedFixedRegret μ Y prediction T = (∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, ∫ ω, (prediction t ω - ∫ ω, Y 0 ω ∂μ)^2 ∂μ) ∧ 0 ≤ expectedFixedRegret μ Y prediction T
